text:
maya: Heads-up: e2e-gpu pipeline is red on master with a timeout in test_kv_store::lease_expiry.
maya: Buildkite: https://buildkite.com/redwood/inference/builds/9876#job-45 (job 9876-45). last green was abcdef12 (earlier today). Can someone help bisect? :thinking_face:
sam: on it. do we think this is infra (scheduling) or a test change? any recent deps?
maya: quick grep shows a test-harness change merged ~3 hours ago (PR 4582) that adjusted default timeouts. not sure if that reduced margins.
oliver: can we just rerun the job first? sometimes it's flake.
ci-bot: Rerun scheduled by maya: https://buildkite.com/redwood/inference/builds/9877#job-45 (rerun 9877-45) :repeat:
maya: rerun finished — same timeout. log snippet:
```
E   TimeoutError: test timed out after 30.0s waiting for lease refresh
  File "tests/e2e/test_kv_store.py", line 143, in test_lease_expiry
    assert lease.refresh()
```
jen: if rerun reproduced, yeah bisect is warranted. sam, want me to kick off git bisect?
sam: I can drive. steps:
```
git checkout master
git bisect start HEAD abcdef12
git bisect run -k ./scripts/run-e2e.sh --filter=kv_store::lease_expiry
```
sam: need the artifacts/fast repro command from the failing job — maya can you paste the repro command or artifact id?
maya: artifact id: artifacts/9876-45/kv_dump.tar.gz. repro command in job: `./test_runner --suite e2e --filter "kv_store::lease_expiry" --timeout 30`
sam: thanks. starting bisect now, will post progress.
sam: quick note while bisecting — I see PR 4582 touched pytest timeout defaults and also updated test harness timeouts to 25s in a couple of places. that aligns with 30s failure after shorter buffer. suspecting PR 4582.
jen: if that's the culprit, we can either revert the harness change or bump the test timeout back. which is faster?
sam: revert is fastest for prod unblock. I'll try to bisect to confirm exact commit.
ci-bot: git bisect session started by sam on buildkite agent-22.
sam: bisect found the bad commit: 1a2b3c4 (PR 4582 by tim). it changes default timeout to 25s and removes a fallback retry in test harness.
leon: can we hotfix by restoring retry locally in harness and open a revert PR?
jen: I'll open the revert PR now and cc @eng-sre to watch deploy.
jen: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4590 (revert PR 4582).
oliver: :thumbsup: nice work.
maya: filed a quick patch build with the revert. triggering CI rerun on master now.
ci-bot: Build triggered for PR 4590: https://buildkite.com/redwood/inference/builds/9880
sam: monitoring. if CI passes we can merge revert and follow up with a better timeout change + regression test.
jen: will add a test to pin the timeout for kv_store leases so this doesn't regress silently.
maya: thanks everyone — that bisect saved us. will merge after green. :white_check_mark:
